articles.event_key: 胡塞武装|袭击|沙特首都阿美大厦及沙特联军空袭也门
articles.title: 胡塞武装称袭击利雅得商业区，沙特称阿美大厦仅轻微损坏
articles.summary: 胡塞武装称11月7日袭击利雅得商业区，未点名阿美大厦；沙特能源部称阿美大厦仅轻微损坏、无伤亡，BBC Verify认证画面显示更严重损坏。胡塞称还袭击利雅得机场和阿美石油储存设施，沙特称拦截多枚导弹。据BBC报道。
articles.new_facts: 胡塞武装称袭击利雅得商业区、未点名阿美大厦；沙特称阿美大厦轻微损坏；BBC Verify显示更严重损坏；胡塞称袭击机场和油储设施。
articles.limitations: 袭击责任由胡塞方面主张；沙特称仅轻微损坏；报道来自BBC，未直接取得沙特官方原文，无法独立核实。

facts.text: 据BBC报道，胡塞武装通过其控制的萨巴通讯社发表声明，称11月7日袭击了沙特首都利雅得的商业区，声明未点名阿美大厦。沙特能源部表示，位于该区域的阿美大厦仅受“轻微损坏”，无人伤亡。BBC Verify认证的画面显示，大厦至少一层受损严重，多层窗户破碎。

evidence.quote: A statement issued via the Houthi-controlled Saba news agency confirmed the group had targeted Riyadh's business zone on Saturday, without mentioning the Aramco Tower by name.
The Saudi energy ministry said the tower had suffered only "minor damage" and no one had been killed or injured.
Footage authenticated by BBC Verify shows more extensive damage to the building, with at least one floor appearing to have been badly hit by a missile or drone strike.
Windows on more than one level appear to have been shattered by the strike.

facts.text: 胡塞武装称还袭击了利雅得机场和阿美石油储存设施。沙特表示防空系统拦截并摧毁了多枚导弹。

evidence.quote: The Houthis also said Riyadh's airport and Aramco oil storage facilities were targeted in separate strikes.
Saudi Arabia said its air defences had intercepted and destroyed several missiles.

bilingual.title_en: Houthis claim attack on Riyadh commercial district; Saudi Arabia says Aramco building only lightly damaged

sentences.en: According to BBC, the Houthi armed group said in a statement issued through Saba news agency, which it controls, that it attacked a commercial district in the Saudi capital Riyadh on November 7; the statement did not name the Aramco building.
sentences.zh: 据BBC报道，胡塞武装通过其控制的萨巴通讯社发表声明，称11月7日袭击了沙特首都利雅得的商业区，声明未点名阿美大厦。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Energy said the Aramco building in the area suffered only "minor damage" and that there were no casualties.
sentences.zh: 沙特能源部表示，位于该区域的阿美大厦仅受“轻微损坏”，无人伤亡。

sentences.en: Footage verified by BBC Verify showed that at least one floor of the building was severely damaged and windows on multiple floors were shattered.
sentences.zh: BBC Verify认证的画面显示，大厦至少一层受损严重，多层窗户破碎。

sentences.en: The Houthi armed group said it also attacked Riyadh airport and Aramco oil storage facilities.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装称还袭击了利雅得机场和阿美石油储存设施。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia said its air defense system intercepted and destroyed multiple missiles.
sentences.zh: 沙特表示防空系统拦截并摧毁了多枚导弹。

articles.event_key: 南非非洲人国民大会（ANC）|遭遇|最差选举结果
articles.title: 南非ANC地方选举得票31%，创历史新低
articles.summary: 据BBC报道，南非执政党非洲人国民大会在地方政府选举中仅获31%全国选票，为1994年以来最差，较2021年的46%大幅下滑。ANC仅在林波波省获多数，民主联盟以25%居第二，MK党10%第三。秘书长姆巴卢拉称结果“灾难性”，总统拉马福萨表示接受人民意志。
articles.new_facts: ANC地方选举得票31%创历史新低；仅林波波省获多数；DA 25%、MK党10%、EFF 6%；姆巴卢拉称“灾难性”；投票率52%。
articles.limitations: 得票率与席位信息来自BBC报道，未直接取得南非独立选举委员会官方结果文件；选举层级为地方政府选举。

facts.text: 据BBC报道，南非执政党非洲人国民大会（ANC）在地方政府选举中仅获31%的全国选票，为该党1994年执政以来最差成绩，较2021年的46%大幅下滑。

evidence.quote: the African National Congress won 31% of the overall vote, one third down from the 46% it gained in 2021
South Africa's ANC has recorded its worst-ever showing in local elections since Nelson Mandela led the country out of apartheid

facts.text: ANC仅在9个省中的林波波省获得多数，上次地方选举为6个省。民主联盟（DA）以25%居第二，前总统祖马领导的MK党以10%居第三，经济自由斗士（EFF）以6%居第四。

evidence.quote: The party won a majority in just one of the country's nine provinces, Limpopo. In 2021 it won six.
The Democratic Alliance (DA) came second in the overall vote with 25%
Former president Jacob Zuma's MK party came third overall with 10%

facts.text: ANC秘书长姆巴卢拉称这是“灾难性”结果。总统拉马福萨表示接受人民意志。本次投票率为52%。

evidence.quote: "This has been a very catastrophic outcome for the ANC," said secretary-general Fikile Mbalula
We accept the will of the people however concerning it might be

bilingual.title_en: South Africa’s ANC falls to 31% in local elections, a historic low

sentences.en: According to the BBC, South Africa’s ruling African National Congress (ANC) won only 31% of the national vote in the local government elections, its worst result since it came to power in 1994, a sharp decline from 46% in 2021.
sentences.zh: 据BBC报道，南非执政党非洲人国民大会（ANC）在地方政府选举中仅获31%的全国选票，为该党1994年执政以来最差成绩，较2021年的46%大幅下滑。

sentences.en: The ANC won a majority in only Limpopo among the nine provinces, compared with six provinces in the previous local elections.
sentences.zh: ANC仅在9个省中的林波波省获得多数，上次地方选举为6个省。

sentences.en: The Democratic Alliance (DA) came second with 25%, the MK party led by former President Zuma third with 10%, and the Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF) fourth with 6%.
sentences.zh: 民主联盟（DA）以25%居第二，前总统祖马领导的MK党以10%居第三，经济自由斗士（EFF）以6%居第四。

sentences.en: ANC Secretary-General Mbalula called the result “catastrophic.”
sentences.zh: ANC秘书长姆巴卢拉称这是“灾难性”结果。

sentences.en: President Ramaphosa said he accepted the will of the people.
sentences.zh: 总统拉马福萨表示接受人民意志。
